answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities the way an ocean absorbs a zephyr: small gusts pass, a flood drowns. Each new identity pays a non-refundable genesis tax of 20 units to join; the tax never returns, so capital cannot be recycled. A single pearl of work earns its fee back, while an attacker forging 100 identities sinks 100 times 20, or 2,000 units, into tax no honest income can recover. Honest agents pay once and keep their full reward whole.
